payload.content:
Use these table-dialog follow-up rules when relevant:
- Resolve follow-up wording such as these, those, their, of these, of those, same, other, or along with against the previous answer set before scanning the whole table.
- When the question asks for one value for each active item, return one value per active item in active-set order. Preserve duplicate values when they correspond to distinct rows.
- For same-as, along-with, other-than, besides, or near-only questions, exclude the anchor entity unless the wording explicitly asks to include it.
- After resolving prior-turn rows, project only the newly requested role column. Do not return whole rows or repeat the role answered in the previous turn.
- For list/all questions, scan all rows in the active or filtered set before answering. Do not stop after the first matching row.
- If the requested answer is an episode number, production code, route number, or other identifier, preserve the identifier surface. If the requested answer is a title or name, return the title/name column instead.

Apply these rules only when they match the question and source evidence. If a rule conflicts with explicit wording or evidence, follow the explicit wording and evidence. Do not change the required output format.

rationale: Backward-compatible coarse SQA rule bundle. New experiments should prefer task_heuristics.sqa_followup_dialog for follow-up behavior and dataset_domain_heuristics.wikitable_surface for source/data heuristics.
